What are the best things to do in Curaçao?
The best things to do in Curaçao include Klein Curaçao day trips, swimming with dolphins, Westcoast Tours, sunset cruises, and off-road buggy tours. These are the island's signature experiences, a mix of offshore adventures and on-island exploration that covers everything Curaçao is known for.
How far in advance should I book these tours?
Book Klein Curaçao at least 3-4 weeks ahead: it books on average 22-30 days in advance, and in peak season (December-March) it sells out weeks before departure. For the other tours on this list, 1-2 weeks is usually enough. All reservations require only a 20% deposit, with free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure.
When is the best time to visit Curaçao?
Curaçao is a year-round destination. It sits outside the Caribbean hurricane belt with stable temperatures around 30°C (86°F) and sunshine throughout the year. Peak season runs December through March: the best weather, and the calmest sea. July and August are popular with European families. For fewer crowds and better prices, October and November are warm, beautiful, and quiet.
Do these tours include hotel pickup?
Most tours on this list have hotel pickup available as an optional add-on for a small extra charge. Some tours depart from fixed marina points such as Jan Thiel or Mambo Boulevard. Full pickup details and pricing are listed on each tour page.
Can I combine multiple tours in one trip?
Yes. Curaçao is a small island and most tours run half or full days. A natural combination: Klein Curaçao takes a full day, a dolphin swim or snorkel tour fits in a half day, and a sunset catamaran rounds off an evening. With 3-4 days you can comfortably experience all the highlights. Our team can help you build the right order.
How does Island Tours choose which tours to feature?
Every tour was selected by the Island Tours team based on one question: would we book this for someone we care about? Commission rates play no role in which tours appear here or in what order. If a tour isn't good enough, it isn't on this list, regardless of what the operator pays.
